name: parkflow
description: Logiciel local de gestion de parking et site de supervision a distance

scripts.dev: concurrently -n cloud,local -c cyan,yellow "npm run dev -w apps/cloud" "npm run dev -w apps/local"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/local && npm run build -w apps/cloud
scripts.test: npm test -w packages/shared && npm test -w apps/local && npm test -w apps/cloud
